summary: Fix #427 fully implements the locked plan. _committed_and_staged_output_is_plan_only was added to quality_methods.py (mirroring the post-agent guard, reusing _committed_paths_since + changed_paths_are_only_internal_plan_artifacts), wired onto the executor in mixins.py, and used to guard the single buggy PLAN_ONLY_OUTPUT site in execution_validation.py (~line 1183) via `and` short-circuit. All planned tests are present in test_executor_coverage_edges_part_009.py: R1 (real committed output proceeds, _fail_if_plan_only_paths not awaited, has_known_non_plan_output=True), R3 (empty committed still fails), R4 (plan-only committed still fails), R-revert (net base..HEAD empty still fails), plus the 4 direct helper unit tests (short-circuit on real staged path, committed real->False, committed empty->True, committed plan-only->True). Non-goals respected: only quality_methods.py, mixins.py, execution_validation.py (+ test + plan/validation docs) changed; execution_flow.py:680-698/1135 and quality_methods.py:949 untouched; PLAN_ONLY_OUTPUT_REASON_CODE unchanged. Focused validation evidence (ruff/format/mypy/targeted pytest + coverage) recorded in the validation doc.
